claim: Exact maximum ordered rainbow Schur-triple counts for every 3-coloring of [n], 1<=n<=12, with optimum multiplicities and color-permutation classes.

correctness_evidence.method: fresh exhaustive enumeration with c(1)=0 symmetry reduction, direct ordered-triple counting, and canonicalization under all six color permutations

literature.title: An Unsure Note on an Un-Schur Problem
literature.coverage: Asymptotic bounds; no exact n<=12 census found.

literature.title: A somewhat sure note on an un-Schur problem
literature.coverage: Improves asymptotic bounds to 9/22 and 8/15; no exact small-n table presented.

literature.author: Thotsaporn Thanatipanonda
literature.title: On the Minimum Number of Monochromatic Generalized Schur Triples
literature.coverage: Earlier formulation of maximizing rainbow x+y=z solutions over 3-colorings and the same parity/interval construction pattern; conjectural rather than an exact finite census.

value_reason: The surviving contribution is an arbitrary small exhaustive table without a structural formula, bound, proof technique, reusable algorithm, or meaningful new regime; its principal construction comparison predates the record and later asymptotic work has already moved beyond it.
repair: Narrowing to a benchmark dataset and correcting historical attribution does not restore sufficient scientific value.
